digest.component_or_area: live DC harness tests / bridge reconciler output contract
propositions: Two live DC harness tests assert on 'OK:' lines that the sync route deliberately suppresses per its documented contract; the emitter is correct and the test assertions are stale.
The canonical sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr for benign outcomes, not OK: on stdout; sync and preview routes suppress OK: per __main__.py:437 gate.

Zero-write idempotence cannot be proven by BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone, since the reconciler marks any pass (including those with N mutations applied) as CONVERGED; must also assert zero RECON differ totals and zero batch_outcome mutation lines.
Test helpers must be re-pointed from OK: stdout parsing to BRIDGE_STATE stderr parsing plus zero-write evidence (both RECON: differ total=0 and zero RECON: batch_outcome lines).
Parsing logic moves to dependency-free _bridge_output.py module to enable unit-testable coverage without live Jira, network, or credentials.
